chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washshā’, who said:

I said to Abī Al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام): “They have narrated from you concerning the death of Abī Al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) that a man said to you: ‘You came to know that through the statement of Sa‘īd.’ So he said: ‘Sa‘īd came after I had known of it, before his coming.’”

He said: “And I heard him saying: ‘I divorced Umm Farwah bint Isḥāq in Rajab, one day after the death of Abī Al-Ḥasan.’ I said: ‘You divorced her while you had known of the death of Abī Al-Ḥasan?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ I said: ‘Before Sa‘īd came to you?’ He said: ‘Yes.’”

key_terms.رَجَبٍ: Rajab; the month in which the event is said to have occurred
key_terms.سَعِيدٍ: the person whose arrival and report are mentioned
key_terms.طَلَّقْتُ: I divorced; an action used to mark the timing
key_terms.مَجِيئِهِ: his coming; the outward arrival of the messenger
key_terms.مَوْتِ: the death being discussed in the report

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate that the Imam (عليه السلام) knew of Abī Al-Ḥasan’s death before receiving outward news?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Imam (عليه السلام) affirmed he had knowledge of the death of Abī Al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) before Sa‘īd arrived with the report. It also records a related personal event used to confirm the timing of that knowledge. The narration is significant in discussions of the Imam’s divinely granted knowledge and the transition of authority.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘They (people) are reporting from you<sup>asws</sup> regarding the passing away of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), that a man said to you, ‘You knew of that (passing away of the 7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup> in prison) by the words of Saeed’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Saeed came after I<sup>asws</sup> had known of it, before his coming’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> divorced Umm Farwa, daughter of Is’haq, after the passing away of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), by one day’. I said, ‘You<sup>asws</sup> divorced her and you<sup>asws</sup> had known of the passing away of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Before the proceeding of Saeed to you<sup>asws</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 3. al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ who has said the following.

“I said to abu al-Hassan (a.s.), ‘They have narrated from you about the death of abu al-Hassan (Musa al-Kazim (a.s.) that a man said to you, “You have learned that (the death of your father) through the report of Sa‘id.” He said, “Sa‘id came after I learned about that (death of my father) before his coming.”

The narrator has said that he asked the Imam (a.s.), “I heard from him that you divorced mother of Farwa, daughter of Ishaq, in the month of Rajab one day after the death of abu al-Hassan (a.s.). Did you divorce her when you knew that abu al-Hassan (a.s.) has died?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Yes, I did so.” I asked him, “Did you do so before Sa‘id came to you?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Yes, I did so before Sa‘id came.”
